artworks.title: Family Walking Through a Zoo Entrance
artworks.alt: A family walks beneath a green ZOO arch decorated with giraffe and elephant silhouettes.
artworks.description: Leaf-topped pillars frame the open green gates. Giraffes, an elephant and broad trees appear beyond the visitors.

artworks.title: Family Reading a Zoo Map
artworks.alt: A woman and two children hold an unfolded zoo map with animal icons and winding paths.
artworks.description: The boy grips one side while the girl points toward the illustrated routes. A penguin, giraffe and butterfly distinguish parts of the map.

artworks.title: Child Collecting a Zoo Ticket
artworks.alt: A child in yellow overalls reaches toward a ticket at a wooden zoo admission booth beside a woman.
artworks.description: The small booth has a green roof and an elephant plaque above its open window. The attendant leans forward for the exchange.

artworks.title: Father and Toddler at the Elephant Habitat
artworks.alt: A father pushes a toddler in a stroller beside a wooden zoo railing overlooking an elephant.
artworks.description: The elephant stands near rocks and a broad green tree beyond the barrier. The stroller and its seated child remain on the visitor path.

artworks.title: Teacher Leading Children Through the Zoo
artworks.alt: A teacher points toward a giraffe as four children walk beneath a wooden ZOO gateway.
artworks.description: The children wear different bright jackets and carry backpacks. Animal-picture activity cards add a school-trip detail to the group.

artworks.title: Watching Wetland Birds from a Zoo Boardwalk
artworks.alt: A silver-haired wheelchair user and a child look at two long-legged birds across a wetland viewing rail.
artworks.description: Reeds rise behind the mesh-sided wooden deck. The child leans forward and points while the adult rests a hand near the wheelchair wheel.

artworks.title: Green Lion Zoo Tram
artworks.alt: A green zoo tram has a friendly lion-faced engine and open passenger carriages.
artworks.description: Gold trim outlines the rounded canopy and small wheels. Seated visitors look out from the two linked cars behind the decorative engine.

artworks.title: Zoo Ticket and Elephant Admission Stamp
artworks.alt: A hand holds an orange ZOO ticket beside a small blue elephant stamp on the wrist.
artworks.description: A giraffe and elephant decorate the ticket. Behind the close-up hand, visitors walk through a wooden entrance beside an elephant viewing area.

artworks.title: Girl Wearing a Zoo Wristband
artworks.alt: A smiling girl fastens a wristband beside blue and orange admission bands and a giraffe visitor pass.
artworks.description: The loose bands curl across the foreground. A giraffe and small habitat sign appear beyond the railing behind her.

artworks.title: Zoo Animal Direction Signpost
artworks.alt: Wooden arrow signs show penguin, giraffe and butterfly illustrations.
artworks.description: A penguin arrow points left; the giraffe and butterfly arrows point right. Leafy shoots grow around the base of the wooden post.

artworks.title: Children at the Hippo Window
artworks.alt: Two children crouch beside a rounded underwater window where a hippopotamus swims past.
artworks.description: Blue water fills the stone-edged opening. The children face one another across the window, wearing purple and green tops with small backpacks.

artworks.title: Photographing a Giraffe at the Zoo
artworks.alt: A short-haired visitor raises a camera toward a giraffe beyond a wooden viewing rail.
artworks.description: A pale sunhat hangs from the visitor backpack. The giraffe leans its long neck into view above the mesh-sided barrier.

artworks.title: Grandfather and Girl Watching a Panda
artworks.alt: A gray-haired grandfather and a girl sit on a bench facing a panda resting on a wooden platform.
artworks.description: The panda rests its front paws along the platform edge. Rocks, bamboo and supporting logs surround the small viewing scene.

artworks.title: Toddler Pointing at Penguins
artworks.alt: A toddler with a red backpack points toward penguins through a tall blue zoo window while holding an adult hand.
artworks.description: The child rises onto one foot in front of the stone window base. The accompanying adult is shown from the shoulders down.

artworks.title: Visitor Sketching a Zebra
artworks.alt: A visitor with round glasses sketches in a notebook while seated opposite a zebra enclosure.
artworks.description: The burgundy sweater and folding stool stand out against the pale habitat wall. The zebra faces the visitor from beyond a wood-and-wire fence.

artworks.title: Friends Watching an Orangutan
artworks.alt: Two friends lean near a zoo viewing rail while an orangutan hangs from overhead ropes.
artworks.description: The orange-haired animal grips two different supports. The visitors wear a lavender headscarf with a denim jacket and a green striped shirt.

artworks.title: Family Walking Beside Flamingos
artworks.alt: A family follows a curved wooden boardwalk beside a pool of pink flamingos.
artworks.description: A red-capped child walks between two adults. Reeds and rocks border the shallow blue pool beyond the railing.

artworks.title: Visitor Looking into an Iguana Terrarium
artworks.alt: A visitor in a navy hoodie leans toward a glass terrarium containing a green iguana.
artworks.description: The iguana lies on a diagonal branch among broad leaves. A small lizard pictogram marks the dark display base.

artworks.title: Girl in the Butterfly House
artworks.alt: A girl in a coral pinafore watches butterflies beneath the curved frame of a glass butterfly house.
artworks.description: Orange and blue butterflies hover near the domed green structure. Flowering plants gather along both sides of the open doorway.

artworks.title: Child at a Beetle Viewing Window
artworks.alt: A curly-haired child in a green raincoat looks through a circular window at a horned beetle.
artworks.description: The round metal frame sits in a wooden panel. Leaves and a rough branch surround the large beetle inside the display.

artworks.title: Watching a Lion Through Public Binoculars
artworks.alt: A visitor in an orange jacket uses mounted binoculars to view a lion resting on rocks.
artworks.description: The public viewing rail separates the visitor from the habitat. A long mane and raised rocky ledge distinguish the reclining lion.

artworks.title: Older Visitors at the Rhino Window
artworks.alt: An older couple stands beside a bench looking at a rhinoceros beyond a zoo viewing wall.
artworks.description: The woman points toward the gray animal while her companion leans closer. Rocks, water and a broad green tree frame the habitat.

artworks.title: Family Visiting the Bat House
artworks.alt: A family watches hanging bats through a purple-lit zoo viewing window.
artworks.description: The rounded dark arch encloses a small nighttime habitat. The child points upward while the two adults stand close behind.

artworks.title: Peacock Crossing the Zoo Path
artworks.alt: A blue-and-green peacock walks across a zoo path while a woman and child pause behind it.
artworks.description: Its long lowered tail trails across the foreground. An animal information panel and curved mesh barrier mark the visitor route.

artworks.title: Visitors Watching a Red Panda in a Tree
artworks.alt: Two visitors lean beside a wooden rail and look up at a red panda resting on a branch.
artworks.description: The reddish animal curls its thick striped tail down the tree. Leaves and rounded rocks create a compact habitat around the viewing area.

artworks.title: Child Inside a Meerkat Viewing Dome
artworks.alt: A child in a yellow cap looks through a clear observation dome at three meerkats.
artworks.description: One meerkat stands upright near the dome while the others sit and walk among the rocks. The sealed dome keeps the child separate from the animals.

artworks.title: Friends at the Sea Lion Window
artworks.alt: A wheelchair user and a standing friend watch a sea lion swim behind a broad underwater window.
artworks.description: The seated visitor points toward the animal. Blue water and faint underwater rocks remain inside the rounded glass opening.

artworks.title: Visitors Crossing an Aviary Bridge
artworks.alt: Two visitors cross a wooden rope bridge beneath two colorful parrots.
artworks.description: The red and blue parrots perch on a leafy branch above the walkway. One visitor wears a yellow jacket while the other carries a backpack over a blue top.

artworks.title: Watching a Mother and Joey at the Zoo
artworks.alt: A woman and child watch a long-tailed marsupial with a joey in its pouch from a visitor path.
artworks.description: The mother animal sits upright beside a small information panel. Low rope posts separate its grassy space from the visitors.

artworks.title: Children Following Zoo Footprints
artworks.alt: Three children compare a zoo activity card with large animal footprint shapes along a path.
artworks.description: One child crouches to touch a print while another holds the card. An elephant habitat and tall giraffes appear beyond the fence.

artworks.title: Father Pulling a Child in a Zoo Wagon
artworks.alt: A father pulls a red wagon carrying a small child with a stuffed animal.
artworks.description: The child sits inside the low wagon wearing a red top. A tiny giraffe tag hangs from the side as the father walks ahead holding the long handle.

artworks.title: Family Picnic at the Zoo
artworks.alt: Four family members share lunch at a wooden picnic table with a giraffe sign.
artworks.description: The gray-haired grandmother wears a blue floral blouse. Open lunchboxes, bread and small fruit pieces sit between the adults and children.

artworks.title: Friends Having Lunch at the Zoo
artworks.alt: Two friends sit beneath a giraffe-topped parasol with a visitor map and drinks.
artworks.description: An adult in a teal shirt holds a drink while the other studies the map. Giraffes and a viewing rail establish the cafe setting.

artworks.title: Choosing a Plush Animal at the Zoo
artworks.alt: A child points toward stuffed animals at a wooden zoo kiosk beside an older woman with glasses.
artworks.description: Pandas, giraffes and elephants fill the shelves beneath a green awning. The companion has a short silver bob, terracotta jumpsuit and pale shoulder bag.

artworks.title: Elephant and Giraffe Photo Board
artworks.alt: Two children put their faces through openings in an elephant-and-giraffe photo board.
artworks.description: The animal bodies are printed on a freestanding wooden display. The children hold the side edges as they smile through the face holes.

artworks.title: Washing Hands After the Petting Area
artworks.alt: A braided girl washes her hands in an outdoor sink beneath a goat pictogram.
artworks.description: Water and small bubbles gather around her hands. The freestanding basin, soap dispenser and exposed support pipes remain clearly visible.

artworks.title: Child and Adult in the Petting Area
artworks.alt: A child in orange overalls gently pets a brown-and-white goat beside an adult.
artworks.description: The child wears a green bucket hat and striped shirt. A dark denim jacket and pale trousers distinguish the adult standing beside the low wooden fence.

artworks.title: Rainy Visit to the Zoo
artworks.alt: An adult and child in blue and yellow raincoats share a clear umbrella outside the zoo.
artworks.description: Their bright ponchos reflect in a small puddle. A wooden ZOO arch and animal-picture signpost stand behind them.

artworks.title: Refilling a Bottle at the Zoo
artworks.alt: A red-haired visitor fills a bottle at a water station beside a giraffe enclosure.
artworks.description: The tall green dispenser carries a giraffe pictogram. The visitor wears a green shirt, gray shorts and a black backpack.

artworks.title: Zoo Birthday Picnic
artworks.alt: Three children wearing animal-themed party hats sit around a birthday cake at a zoo picnic table.
artworks.description: A lion crown, elephant-ear hat and striped animal headband give each child a different look. An elephant and giraffe appear beyond the fence.

artworks.title: Lantern Tour Beside an Owl Enclosure
artworks.alt: A guide carrying a lantern leads a woman and child beside an owl enclosure in black-and-white line art.
artworks.description: The owl perches on a branch behind mesh. Boots, backpacks and the hanging lantern distinguish the three visitors along the path.

artworks.title: Children at a Giraffe Playground Slide
artworks.alt: Children climb and wait beside a giraffe-shaped playground slide in black-and-white line art.
artworks.description: A long curved chute descends from the tall giraffe structure. Steps and handrails lead to the small platform above.

artworks.title: School Trip Arriving at the Zoo
artworks.alt: A teacher and children step from a school bus beside a ZOO ARRIVAL sign in black-and-white line art.
artworks.description: The open bus doorway fills one side of the scene. An elephant pictogram and distant habitat fence mark the arrival point.

artworks.title: Returning a Lost Plush Penguin
artworks.alt: A zoo attendant hands a plush penguin to a child across a guest-services counter in black-and-white line art.
artworks.description: A mitten-and-toy pictogram marks the counter. The child reaches up with both hands while the attendant leans forward.

artworks.title: Visitors at a Zoo Map Kiosk
artworks.alt: Two visitors stand beside a freestanding animal-picture map kiosk in black-and-white line art.
artworks.description: The taller visitor points toward a circular animal symbol. A younger companion holds a folded map while both look at the roofed display.

artworks.title: Family Posing for a Zoo Photograph
artworks.alt: A family of four poses on a curved animal-decorated bench before a tripod camera in black-and-white line art.
artworks.description: The two children sit between the adults. Small animal silhouettes along the bench back reinforce the zoo setting.

artworks.title: Visitor Exploring an Elephant Relief Panel
artworks.alt: A visitor with sunglasses and a white cane touches an elephant relief panel beside a child in black-and-white line art.
artworks.description: The sloping panel stands at hand height near an elephant viewing area. The child watches the adult trace the raised animal shape.

artworks.title: Zoo Activity Clipboard and Binoculars
artworks.alt: An animal checklist clipboard, pencil and binoculars form a black-and-white outline still life.
artworks.description: Elephant, penguin, giraffe and butterfly pictures sit beside four empty checkboxes. The tilted clipboard and binoculars remain separate, easy-to-see objects.

artworks.title: Waving Goodbye at the Zoo Exit
artworks.alt: A child carrying a souvenir bag waves beside an exit arch with a right-pointing arrow in black-and-white line art.
artworks.description: Animal faces decorate the backpack and bag. A giraffe and elephant appear beyond the simple gate.

artworks.title: Resting Beside the Tortoise Habitat
artworks.alt: An older visitor and child sit on a bench beside two tortoises in black-and-white line art.
artworks.description: The tortoises occupy a raised grassy area behind a low wall. The wide bench scene leaves generous open shapes for coloring.
